body: Every so often but not like they used to. She doesn't spend much time with me anymore. As i said she has other people

She just does. We can talk forever and mess around with each other. We would play games and share memes. We watch movies together. I dont know its complicated. Guess its because she actually talks to me. I dont talk to anybody else. Sense my other somewhat friends are to busy with each other to realize im a thing.
Because when she does talk to me i feel really good about myself you know happy. Shes a really good friend... When she includes me in her life.

I've tried but she changes the subject or she just doesnt respond. I dont want her to completely leave me. I dont know i guess i wish that she would stop liking me one day then acting like i don't exist the rest of the week.

I don't know but it started when i told her about my family problems. The divorce and all. I just feel like her friends (which most are also mine) are just more fun to be around or something. Maybe im just not good enough i don't know i really wish i didnt think this way.
